author: Jarl
body:
Yo,

Just want to get in a team to scrim every now and then, I can put the effort to practice for a tourney if my team needs to and if their roster is good enough to pretend winning anything. Took about 1.5 year of break but I'm still as good after practicing for a bit, played a bit more recently. 

most recent mc clip : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2907TPfXpfU
older video of mine : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bB4dWBvtRMw 

I'm as good with sword and bow, can do everything in a scrim except defend. 

Experience :
7 OCN tourneys : 1 * WIN (Conquest 2 - Street Sharks) | 1 * 2nd place | 3 * top 3 | 1 * 5th  | 1 * top 16

edit : Discord name : Jarl#5026
